headline: Basin rig count down one as prices rise
summary: The rig count in the Permian Basin was down one this week, the latest count Friday by Baker Hughes shows, with 258 rigs active in the region. A year ago, 260 rigs were active in the region. Nationally, the oil and gas rig count is down one from last week at 587 rigs. A year ago, 542 rigs were active.
